description: This file is a Cypress configuration script for testing the OrangeHRM application. It sets up Cypress environment settings, references, and custom tasks for database management such as creating savepoints, restoring, deleting, resetting, and truncating tables.

methods.name: asyncWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a promise to handle success and error, returning a tuple with the result or error.

methods.name: createSavePoint
methods.description: Creates a database savepoint with the specified name via an API call.

methods.name: restoreToSavePoint
methods.description: Restores the database to a specified savepoint via an API call.

methods.name: deleteSavePoints
methods.description: Deletes specified savepoints through an API request.

methods.name: resetDatabase
methods.description: Resets the database to its initial state via an API call.

methods.name: truncateTable
methods.description: Truncates (clears data from) specified tables in the database.
